title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

reports.title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

summary:
New Jersey fined DataOne $1.07 million after state inspectors found 62 tractor trailer size natural gas generators at its Vineland data center site in late July. The 2,000 kilowatt generators lacked required permits to be installed or operated. Officials said the penalty for violating the Air Pollution Control Act is the largest ever issued to a data center operator in New Jersey. The fine was issued Tuesday.

The Vineland campus is planned as a 2.6 million square foot complex needing 350 megawatts, enough for a medium size city, and is scheduled for completion at the end of the year. Some of it is already in use. It has drawn complaints since zoning, including a federal lawsuit by homeowners over persistent noise and violation orders from the Cumberland County Health Department for excessive noise. Governor Mikie Sherrill said data center builders must benefit New Jersey communities.
